answer: The river schedule is applied in shale and harbor makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 37% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2978 identities would post 736 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
